name: support-case-insights
description: Support Case Insights: AWS CDK application that collects resolved AWS Support cases across an AWS Organization and enriches them with Amazon Bedrock.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:py
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ts && npm run typecheck:py
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
scripts.synth: cdk synth -c env=dev --no-lookups --quiet --output cdk.out/dev && cdk synth -c env=prod --no-lookups --quiet --output cdk.out/prod
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run synth
scripts.security: npm run security:npm && npm run security:py
